rulesets.prop: Match the art style of the reference image EXACTLY: hand-drawn pixel art, same dot size, same limited earthy palette, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, 3/4 top-down quarter view with a ~30 degree downward camera. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. A single object centered in frame, no text, no border, no extra props. The object stands alone with nothing drawn beneath it. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF.
